en: This differential from XER is the least durable and cheapest differential on the market for Rally2 cars, due to its used condition and low quality. It offers no custom tuning abilities and should only be purchased if you are on an extremely tight budget.

Esto Perpetua's refurbished differential is a bit more durable than the used XER part. It also allows you to tune the preload of the differential too. However, this does mean it is more expensive than the used part.

Avolo's brand new Rally2 differential is the most durable LSD there is. Avolo also offer full custom tuning abilities with this part too. Preload, driving lock and braking lock can all be adjusted. This part is the most expensive out of the four though.
Sújú's radiator is a very durable option, stronger than the 7even and X-Förmig radiators, for a slightly increased price.
This X-Förmig Radiator is the least durable radiator on the market, but is it also the cheapest too.
7even offer a refurbished radiator which is more durable than the X-Förmig part. It's a bit more expensive though.

The Tri Star radiator is the strongest and most durable radiator available. This does cost more but Tri Star offer a significant improvement in durability compared to the other radiators on the market.
Esto Perpetua's radiator is a very durable option, stronger than the Xenon and 7even radiators, for a slightly increased price.
7even offer a refurbished radiator which is more durable than the Xenon part. It's slightly more expensive however.
Polor's radiator is a very durable option, stronger than the Xenon and Esto Perpetua radiators, for a slightly increased price.
This Xenon Dynamics radiator is the least durable radiator on the market, but is it also the cheapest too.
Esto Perpetua offer a refurbished radiator which is more durable than the Xenon part. It's slightly more expensive however.

The new suspension kit manufactured by Esto Perpetua is more durable than the Polor kit but does come at an increased price. This Esto Perpetua kit also allows you to adjust both ride height and dampers.
XER offer a low quality used suspension kit for Rally1 cars. This kit does not allow for any tuning capabilities and is the least durable kit out of the four on the market.
The suspension kit from Polor has been refurbished and as a result is more durable than the used kit from XER. The kit from Polor also allows you to tune the ride height of your car.

JPB have made the most durable suspension kit available for Rally1 cars. It is the most expensive kit but has all of the custom tuning abilities that you could ask for. This kit allows you to adjust ride height, springs and dampers.

The new suspension kit manufactured by Euterpe is more durable than the Asiatic Dynamics kit but does come at an increased price. This Euterpe kit also allows you to adjust both ride height and dampers.
Avolo offer a low quality used suspension kit for Rally2 cars. This kit does not allow for any tuning capabilities and is the least durable kit out of the four on the market.

The suspension kit from Asiatic Dynamics has been refurbished and as a result is more durable than the used kit from Avolo. The kit from Asiatic Dynamics also allows you to tune the ride height of your car.

JPB have made the most durable suspension kit available for Rally2 cars. It is the most expensive kit but has all of the custom tuning abilities that you could ever ask for. This kit allows you to adjust ride height, springs and dampers.
The new suspension kit manufactured by Loop is more durable than the Echo kit but does come at an increased price. This Loop kit also allows you to adjust both ride height and dampers.
Equinox offer a low quality used suspension kit for Rally3 cars. This kit does not allow for any tuning capabilities and is the least durable kit out of the four on the market.
The suspension kit from Echo has been refurbished and as a result is more durable than the used kit from Equinox. The kit from Echo also allows you to tune the ride height of your car.

This 1.5L turbocharged engine from A+F has been refurbished and is more durable than the used Duotone counterpart. Factoring in price and quality, this is the most all-round option out of the three 1.5L turbo engines. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Duotone's used 1.5L turbocharged engine will be much less durable than the refurbished-high or new-very high variants, as it is only of medium quality. However, this does mean it's the cheapest. All engines provide the same level of performance.

The brand new 1.5L turbocharged engine from Tri Star is the most durable 1.5L turbo engine on the market, this makes it the strongest and longest lasting engine of the three variants, but this does come at a greater cost. All engines provide the same level of performance.

The brand new 1.6L turbocharged engine from Esto Perpetua is the most durable 1.6L turbo engine on the Rally2 market, this makes it one of the strongest and longest lasting engine of the four variants, but this does come at a greater cost. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Duotone's used 1.6L turbocharged engine will be much less durable than the refurbished-high or new-very high variants, as it is only of medium quality. However, this does mean it's the cheapest. All engines provide the same level of performance.

This 1.6L turbocharged engine from Loop has been refurbished and is more durable than its used counterpart. Factoring in price and quality, this is the most all-round option out of the four 1.6L turbo engines. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Achevée's new 1.6L turbocharged engine will be much more durable than the refurbished or used variants or the new Esto Perpetua engine, as it is of very high quality. However, this does mean it costs the most. All engines provide the same level of performance.

The new 1.6L turbocharged hybrid engine from Asiatic Dynamics is one of the most durable on the Rally1 market. Factoring in price and quality, this is the most all-round option out of the 1.6L turbo hybrid engines. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Duotone's used 1.6L turbocharged hybrid engine will be much less durable than the refurbished or new variants. However, this does mean it's the cheapest. All engines provide the same level of performance.
This 1.6L turbocharged hybrid engine from Sújú has been refurbished and is more durable than its used counterpart. All engines provide the same level of performance.

This brand new 1.6L turbo-hybrid engine is the same engine that is used in the M-Sport Ford Puma Rally1, making it one of the best engines on the market. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Hyundai Motorsport's 1.6L turbo-hybrid engine is the same engine that they run in their Hyundai I20 N Rally1 in the World Rally Championship. This engine has durability that is rated best in class. All engines provide the same level of performance.

The 1.6L turbocharged hybrid engine from Toyota Gazoo Racing has great durability and is also rated best in class. This engine is used in Toyota's GR Yaris Rally1 that is currently being used to compete in the World Rally Championship. All engines provide the same level of performance.

This 1L turbocharged engine from Equinox has been refurbished and is more durable than its used counterpart. Factoring in price and quality, this is the most all-round option out of the three 1L turbo engines. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Asiatic Dynamics' used 1L turbocharged engine will be much less durable than the refurbished-high or new-very high variants, as it is only of medium quality. However, this does mean it's the cheapest. All engines provide the same level of performance.

The brand new 1L turbocharged engine from Achevée is the most durable 1L turbo engine on the market, this makes it the strongest and longest lasting engine of the three variants, but this does come at a greater cost. All engines provide the same level of performance.

Damage to the bodywork can majorly affect the amount of downforce generated by the aero resulting in less grip.
Worn brakes will cause brake fade, making them less effective.
A worn clutch results in a reduced amount of friction, causing it to slip, and therefore wear at a faster rate.
Differential damage can result in gears becoming seized together or a loss of fluid, severely impairing cornering.
Damage to the engine can cause a major loss of power and could result in complete engine failure.
A damaged exhaust system will result in a minor drop in engine power.
A damaged turbo will result in a catastrophic decrease in engine power.
Damage to the gearbox could result in a loss of certain gears, longer shift time or complete failure of the gearbox.
Damage to the lights can result in a reduction in visibility in low light stages.
Radiator damage can cause the engine to overheat and start to wear at a faster rate.
Damage to the steering will affect front wheel alignment, making precise cornering more difficult.
A damaged suspension will majorly affect corner capabilities and make the car difficult to keep under control.
